description: This file defines public APIs and register offsets for the Local Advanced Programmable Interrupt Controller (LOAPIC) in the Zephyr RTOS, including functions for reading/writing registers and sending IPIs in x86 architecture.

methods.name: x86_read_x2apic
methods.description: Reads a 64-bit value from the local APIC in x2APIC mode.

methods.name: x86_read_xapic
methods.description: Reads a 32-bit value from the local APIC in xAPIC (MMIO) mode.

methods.name: x86_read_loapic
methods.description: Reads a 32-bit value from the local APIC using the default mode (x2APIC or xAPIC).

methods.name: x86_write_x2apic
methods.description: Writes a 64-bit value to the local APIC in x2APIC mode.

methods.name: x86_write_xapic
methods.description: Writes a 32-bit value to the local APIC in xAPIC (MMIO) mode.

methods.name: x86_write_loapic
methods.description: Writes a 32-bit value to the local APIC using the default mode.

methods.name: z_loapic_ipi
methods.description: Sends an Inter-Processor Interrupt (IPI) to a target CPU via the local APIC.
